results.title: Costs | MIT Course Catalog
results.snippet: The estimated cost of attendance for the 2026–2027 academic year is $93,730. However, most students pay far less than this amount because of our generous financial aid; in 2025–2026, about 60% of MIT students received financial aid, and about 40% of students attended MIT tuition-free.

results.title: Cost of attendance | MIT Student Financial Services
results.snippet: The cost of attendance (COA) is our best estimate—based on defined costs set by MIT and surveys of our students—of what we expect it to cost an undergraduate to attend MIT for one academic year as a full-time student. ⁠It includes fixed costs that are billed by MIT (such as tuition, housing, food), and variable estimates for other expenses (such as books, supplies, and personal expenses).
